# FDG9007

> DO provide a default or a very simple constructor for all aggregate components.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.1.3 Aggregate Component Guidelines.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

Not an analyzer candidate: only aggregate components need a default or very simple constructor, and whether a type is one cannot be told from its declaration; factored types should instead take their required settings in the constructor (section 9.1.1).
